0.headline: SFC Environmental Technologies IPO subscribed 67% so far on Day 3; check latest GMP
0.heading: SFC Environmental Technologies IPO subscribed 67% so far on Day 3; check latest GMP
0.intro: The initial public offering (IPO) of SFC Environmental Technologies saw a pick-up in investor demand on the last day of bidding, with the issue receiving 67 percent subscription by 12:15 pm on October 29, as per NSE data.
0.body:
The initial public offering (IPO) of SFC Environmental Technologies saw a pick-up in investor demand on the last day of bidding, with the issue receiving 67 percent subscription by 12:15 pm on October 29, as per NSE data.

The Rs 667.5 crore IPO recorded bids for 94,20,390 shares against 1,41,59,744 shares on offer. Non-institutional investors led the demand with 1.08 times subscription, followed by retail investors with 52 percent subscription.

In the grey market, SFC Environmental Technologies shares were commanding a grey market premium of 2 percent on the morning of October 29, as per InvestorGain.

Read Also: Bombay Coated and Special Steels IPO fully subscribed in opening hours; QIB portion booked over 3x

The grey market premium is an unofficial indicator of investor sentiment towards a public issue before its listing. However, it does not guarantee listing gains, and the premium can fluctuate depending on market conditions and investor demand.

The company has fixed the IPO price band at Rs 313–330 per share. At the upper end of the price band, SFC Environmental Technologies is valued at Rs 3,232.5 crore.

The IPO comprises a fresh issue of Rs 150 crore and an offer for sale (OFS) of 1.56 crore equity shares worth Rs 517.5 crore. While the proceeds from the fresh issue will go to the company, the OFS component will allow existing shareholders, including promoters, to sell their shares.

Investors can bid for a minimum of 45 equity shares and in multiples of 45 shares thereafter.

At the upper end of the price band of Rs 330 per share, the minimum investment for retail investors will be Rs 14,850. The maximum investment for a retail investor under the individual retail category will be Rs 1,93,050, equivalent to 585 shares.

The company's shares are expected to list on the stock exchanges on November 3.

Check IPO News Here

The company posted a profit of Rs 1.5 crore in the first quarter of FY27, compared with a loss of Rs 1.3 crore in the corresponding quarter of the previous financial year.

Revenue nearly doubled to Rs 133.9 crore in the quarter ended June 2026, from Rs 67.8 crore in the year-ago period.

The company plans to use Rs 42.2 crore from the net proceeds of the fresh issue to repay debt and Rs 74.9 crore to meet working capital requirements. The remaining proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes.

Incorporated in 2005, SFC Environmental Technologies provides engineering solutions across wastewater treatment, wastewater recycling and reuse, and solid waste treatment.

1.headline: Bombay Coated and Special Steels IPO fully subscribed in opening hours; QIB portion booked over 3x
1.heading: Bombay Coated and Special Steels IPO fully subscribed in opening hours; QIB portion booked over 3x
1.intro: The initial public offering (IPO) of Bombay Coated & Special Steels opened for subscription today, with the issue receiving 1.12 times subscription by 11:20 am on October 29, as per NSE data.
1.body:
The initial public offering (IPO) of Bombay Coated &amp; Special Steels opened for subscription today, with the issue receiving 1.12 times subscription by 11:20 am on October 29, as per NSE data.

The Rs 183.06 crore IPO received bids for 1,85,59,086 shares against 1,65,33,012 shares on offer. Qualified institutional buyers led the demand with 3.28 times subscription, followed by retail investors with 30 percent subscription.

In the grey market, Bombay Coated &amp; Special Steels shares were commanding a premium of 11 percent on the morning of October 29, according to InvestorGain. However, the GMP is an unofficial indicator of investor sentiment and does not guarantee the listing price or returns.

Read Also: BLS Polymers IPO subscribed over 45x so far on Day 3; GMP jumps to 34%

The company has fixed the price band for the issue at Rs 78-82 per share. Investors can apply for a minimum of 182 shares in one lot, requiring an investment of Rs 14,924 at the upper end of the price band.

The IPO will remain open for bidding until November 2. The tentative listing date for Bombay Coated &amp; Special Steels shares on the BSE and NSE is November 5.

The IPO comprises an entirely fresh issue of shares worth Rs 183.06 crore. The company plans to utilise a substantial portion of the proceeds to reduce its debt and meet costs associated with capital equipment.

Of the net proceeds, Rs 125 crore will be used to repay or prepay certain borrowings. Another Rs 15.77 crore has been earmarked for costs related to acquiring capital equipment under existing lease arrangements with Siemens Financial Services Pvt. Ltd. The remaining proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes.

Check IPO News Here

Bombay Coated &amp; Special Steels reported an improvement in its revenue and profit in fiscal 2026. Revenue from operations rose to Rs 1,266.82 crore in FY26 from Rs 1,055.71 crore in FY25. The company had reported revenue of Rs 755.26 crore in FY24.

Profit after tax (PAT) increased to Rs 30.54 crore in FY26, compared with Rs 28.67 crore in FY25 and Rs 21.14 crore in FY24.

For the quarter ended June 2026, the company reported revenue from operations of Rs 397.08 crore and a profit after tax of Rs 15.08 crore.

About Bombay Coated &amp; Special Steels

Bombay Coated &amp; Special Steels is a steel processing company that converts steel coils into processed steel products through operations such as slitting, cut-to-length processing, shearing and embossing.

The company's manufacturing facilities are located in Wada and Bhiwandi in Maharashtra, Ghiloth in Rajasthan, and Sri City in Andhra Pradesh.

It caters to industrial customers that require processed steel for their operations. As of June 30, 2026, the company had an aggregate installed processing capacity of 1,23,153 tonnes per annum.

2.headline: M K Sons Fine Jewels IPO subscribed 74% so far on Day 2; check latest GMP
2.heading: M K Sons Fine Jewels IPO subscribed 74% so far on Day 2; check latest GMP
2.intro: The initial public offering (IPO) of M K Sons Fine Jewels continued to draw strong investor interest on the second day of bidding, with the issue receiving 74 percent subscription by 10:40 am on October 29, according to NSE data.
2.body:
The initial public offering (IPO) of M K Sons Fine Jewels continued to draw strong investor interest on the second day of bidding, with the issue receiving 74 percent subscription by 10:40 am on October 29, according to NSE data.

The Rs 275.4-crore IPO received bids for 87,86,505 shares against 1,19,00,000 shares on offer. The national institutional investors led the demand with 1.36 times subscription, followed by the qualified institutional buyers category, which saw 96 percent subscription. The retail portion was subscribed 35 percent.

In the grey market, M K Sons Fine Jewels shares were commanding a premium of 9 percent on the morning of October 29, as per InvestorGain.

Read Also: BLS Polymers IPO subscribed over 45x so far on Day 3; GMP jumps to 34%

The grey market premium is an unofficial indicator of investor sentiment towards a public issue before its listing. However, it does not guarantee listing gains, and the premium can fluctuate depending on market conditions and investor demand.

The company has fixed the price band for the IPO at Rs 153-162 per share, valuing the company at around Rs 912 crore at the upper end of the band.

The bidding will close on October 30. The share allotment is expected to be finalised by November 2, while the company's shares are scheduled to list on the stock exchanges on November 4.

The IPO comprises 1.7 crore equity shares, including a fresh issue of 1.36 crore shares worth Rs 220.32 crore at the upper end of the price band. The remaining portion of the issue comprises an offer for sale (OFS).

The company plans to use the proceeds from the fresh issue primarily to expand its retail footprint and reduce debt.

Of the net proceeds, Rs 152.8 crore will be allocated towards setting up a new showroom in Maharashtra and expanding an existing showroom in Gujarat. Another Rs 30 crore will be used to repay debt, while the remaining amount will be utilised for general corporate purposes.

On the financial side, the company reported revenue of Rs 538.7 crore for the financial year ended March 2026, marking a 53.4% increase from Rs 351.3 crore in the previous financial year. Its profit more than doubled to Rs 51.8 crore in FY26 from Rs 23.3 crore a year earlier.

Check IPO News Here

For the quarter ended June 2026, the company reported a profit of Rs 15 crore on revenue of Rs 101.4 crore.

Aryaman Financial Services has been appointed as the merchant banker for the issue.

About M K Sons Fine Jewels

M K Sons Fine Jewels is a Mumbai-based jewellery retailer that sells gold, diamond and cubic zirconia (CZ) jewellery through its own retail showrooms.

The company currently operates five showrooms, including three in Mumbai and two in Ahmedabad. The proposed expansion is expected to support its plans to increase its retail presence.
